What We Offer

Comprehensive Residential Care Services

Every service we provide is built around one goal — helping children grow, heal, and move toward a stable and fulfilling future.

Behavioral Residential Services

Safe, structured residential placements with 24/7 therapeutic support in a nurturing home environment designed for behavioral health needs.

Learn more ›

Youth Support Programs

Tailored programs focused on emotional regulation, social skills, academic support, and behavioral growth.

Learn more ›

Family-Centered Care

We keep families actively involved at every stage — building communication, repairing bonds, and preparing children for successful transitions home.

Learn more ›

Structured Daily Living

Consistent routines and life skills programming that teach responsibility, independence, and self-regulation through daily practice.

Learn more ›

Individual Development Planning

Personalized development plans created with families, caseworkers, and clinical staff — setting measurable goals and clear paths forward.

Learn more ›

Safe Residential Placement

A secure, stable placement for children who need structured residential support — staffed by trained professionals committed to safety and growth.

Why Families Choose Us

More Than a Placement — A Path Forward

We don't just provide a place to stay. We provide a structured foundation where children can begin to heal, grow, and build the skills they need for a successful future.

Structured, Therapeutic Environment

Consistent routines and clear expectations create the safety and predictability children with behavioral needs require to thrive.

Trained, Compassionate Staff

Our team is specifically trained in behavioral health support and committed to treating every child with dignity, patience, and genuine care.

Transparent Family Communication

Families and referral sources receive regular updates on progress and planning — because true collaboration leads to better outcomes.

Focused on Long-Term Success

Our goal isn't just stabilization — it's equipping every child with the confidence and support network to succeed beyond our care.

Every child deserves a safe place to grow, a structured environment to heal, and a compassionate team that believes in their potential — no matter where they've been.

Preferred Residential Homes — Our Mission
Our Mission & Vision

Driven by Purpose, Built for Children

Preferred Residential Homes was founded with a singular purpose: to create a residential environment where children and youth experiencing behavioral health challenges can find safety, stability, and a genuine path forward.

We believe that with the right structure, compassionate care, and family involvement, every child has the capacity to grow — and we are committed to building that environment every single day.
